text.S1: There once was a little girl whose hair was bright and yellow, and it glittered in the sun like spun-gold. Her name was Goldi-Locs.
text.T1: Kwaliko akanakashi akakwete umushishi uwayaka kabili mutuntulwa-mutuntulwa,Elyo walebeeka mukasubanga golide. Ishina lyakakashana lyali Goldi-Locs.
text.T2: Kwali akanakashi akakwet imishishi isha buuta nga kasuba mutuntulwa-mutuntulwa. elyo shalebeka mu Kasuba nga golide. Ishina lyakwe ali ni Goldi-Locs

text.S1: One day Goldi-Locs went out to gather flowers. She wandered on and on, and after a while she came to a forest, where she had never been before. She went into the forest, which was very cool and shady.
text.T1: Bushiku bumo Goldi-Locs aile mukusaba amaluba. Aile aleendauka, nshita- nshita asanga impanga yampenda mabula, iyo tataalafikako. Ilyo aingile muliimpanga, mwali umwatalalila kabili necintelelwe.
text.T2: Ubushiku bumo Goldi-locs aile mukutola amaluba. Aile aleendauka, lintu papitile inshita afikile ku mpanga, uko tatalile fika akale. Aingile mu mpanga, umwali umwatalala necintelelwe.

text.S1: She came to a house standing all alone in the forest. She knocked at the door, as she was tired, hungry and thirsty, and she hoped the good people inside would give her some food and drink, and let her rest a little while.
text.T1: Afikile panganda iyalifye yeka mukati kampanga. Akonkweshe pa ciibi, ici ali uwanaka, insala necilaka, alicetekele abantu ababa bwino ukuba mu ng'anda bengamupelako ifyakulya na ukunwa, kabili benga muleka ukuti engatushako panoono.
text.T2: Afikile ku ng'anda iyalifye yeka mu mpanga. Akonkweshe pa ciibi, ici alinakile, nensala ne cilaka, balimuleka ukuti engatushako panoono.

text.S1: Although Goldi-Locs did not know it, this house belonged to three lions. There was GREAT BIG FATHER LION, mid-sized mother lion, and dear little baby lion who was no bigger than Goldi-Locs. The three lions had gone out for a walk while their supper was cooling, so when Goldi-Locs knocked at the door no one answered.
text.T1: Nelyo Goldi-Locs talati eshibe, ii ng'anda yali ni ng'anda ya nkalamo shitatu. Kwali ICIPAMFI CIWISHI CA NKALAMO, na nyina wankalamo umu noonoko elyo nakamwana ka nkalamo akasha kulile ukucila Goldi-Locs. Ishi nkalamo shaile shilapitana apo ifilyo fyabo fyaletalala, eico Ilyo Goldi-Locs ale konkonsha pa ciibi tapali nangu umo uwa yaswike.
text.T2: Nelyo Goldi-locs taishibe, ii ng'anda abene bali ni nkalamo shitatu. Kwali WISHI INKALAMO, na nyina nkalamo elyo nomunoono ushapusene sana umubili na Goldi-locs. Ishi nkalamo shaile shilepitana apo ifilyo fyabo fyaletalala, eico ilyo Goldi-locs alekonkonsha pa ciibi tapali uwa mwaswike nangu umo.

text.S1: She paused and she knocked again. As nobody answered she pushed the door open and stepped inside. There in a row stood three chairs. One was a GREAT BIG CHAIR, and it belonged to the father lion. And one was a middling-sized chair, and it belonged to the mother lion, and one was a dear little chair, and it belonged to the baby lion. And on the table stood three bowls of smoking hot porridge. “And so,” thought Goldi-Locs, “people must be coming back soon to eat it.”
text.T1: Atala aleka cinono elyo aisa konkonsha nakabili. Tapali nangu umo uwaiswileko epakusunke ciibi aingila na mukati. Pantambalilo paali ifipuna fitatu. Icakubalilapo cali ICIKALAMBA NGANSHI ICIPUNA,ici cali cabawishi nkalamo, icakonkelepo cali pakati kabukulu,cena cali cabanyina nkalamo elyo nakanoono akali kamwana wankalamo. Elyo patebulo paali imbale shitatu ishamusunga walefuuka necushi kukukaaba."Elyo ifi." Efyatontonkenye Goldi-Locs, "abantu bafwile balaisa mukulya nombaline."

text.S1: She thought she would sit down and rest until they came. First she sat down in the GREAT BIG CHAIR, but the cushion was too soft. It seemed as though she would be swallowed. Then she sat down in the middle-sized chair, and the cushion was too hard, and it was not comfortable. Then she sat down in the dear little chair, and it was just right. It fitted her as though it had been made for her. So there she sat, and she rocked and she rocked, and she sat and she sat, until with her rocking and her sitting she sat the bottom right out of it.
text.T1: Kabili tapali nangu umo uwaishile.Mulyamwine umwabelele imbale sha musunga wakumonekela ku mwana wankalamo.
text.T2: Takwali abaishile nangu bamo. Mulya mwine umwabelele imbale sha musunga wakumona ku mwana nkalamo.

text.S1: Goldi-Locs lay down on the GREAT BIG BED to try it, but the pillow was too firm and she wasn’t comfortable at all.
text.T1: Goldi-Locs alambalala pa BUSAANSHI UBUKALAMBA NGANSHI ukuti engesha, Lelo umusaowakusailapo umutwe walikoseshe kabili tawaleumfika bwino nakalya.
text.T2: Goldi-locs efyo alambalele pa BUSAANSHI UMUKALAMBA ukwesha sendama, lelo wakusailapo umutwe walikoseshe kabilitawale umfwika bwinonakalya.

text.S1: Then she lay down on the middle-sized bed, and the pillow was too soft, and that wasn’t comfortable either.
text.T1: Elyo alambalala pabusaanshi bwapakati mubukalamba,kabili umusao wakusailapo umutwe wali nakiishe nalyo line taumfwile bwino.
text.T2: Elyo alambalala pa busanshi bwa pakati mubukalamba, kabili wakusailapo umutwe wali nakiishe nalyo taumfwile bwino.

text.S1: Then she lay down on the dear little bed and it was exactly right, and so very comfortable that she lay there and lay there until she went fast asleep.
text.T1: Elyo alambalele pakabusaanshi akanoono no kumuliinga kalimulingile bwino bwino, alambalele palya peene mpaka apona namutulo.
text.T2: Elyo asendeme pa busanshi ubunoono no kumulinga kali mulinga kwati eobapangile, asendeme palya peene mpaka apona namutulo.

text.S1: While Goldi-Locs was still asleep in the little bed, the three lions came home again, and as soon as they stepped inside the door and looked around, they knew that somebody had been there.
text.T1: Cilya Goldi-Locs acili nasendama mutulo pa kabusaanshi akanoono, inkalamo shitatu shalibwelele ku ng'anda, cilyafye shaingila mukati ka ciibi shaishiba nokwishiba ukuti kwali uwalimo.
text.T2: Cilya Goldi-locs acili nasendama pabusaanshi ubunoono, inkalamo shitatu shali bwela ku ng'anda, cilya fye shaingila mukati ka ciibi shali ishiba ukuti kwli uwaishilemo.

text.S1: "SOMEBODY’S BEEN SITTING IN MY CHAIR,” growled the father lion in his great big voice, “AND LEFT THE CUSHION CROOKED.”
text.T1: "KULI UWACIKALA MU CIPUNA CANDI," efyabulwime wishi nkalamo mucilishiwi icikalamba, "ASHA NO MUSAO UWALUBANA."
text.T2: "KWACIBA UWACIKALA MU CIPUNA CANDI", efyabulwime wishi nkalamo mucilishiwi icikalamba, "ASHA NO MUSAO UWALUBANA".

text.S1: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” said the mother lion, “and left it standing crooked.”
text.T1: "Elyo kuli uwacikala mucipuna candi ," efyasosele baana nkalamo, " asha naciminina ifyalubana."
text.T2: "Elyo kuli uwacikala mu cipuna candi", efyasosele nyina nkalamo", asha naciminina ifyalubana".

text.S1: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” squeaked the baby lion, in his shrill little voice, “and they broke it”; and he felt very sad about it.
text.T1: "Elyo kuli uwacikala mucipuna candi,'' efyasasawike akana ka nkalamo mukalishiwi akanoono,"elobakontola", elyo kalyumfwile ububi Pali Ici.
text.T2: "Elyo kuli uwacikala mu cipuna candi ", efyasasawike akaana ka nkalamo mukali shiwi akanoono," elobakontola", elyo kalyumfwile ububi pali ici.

text.S1: Then the three lions went over to the table to get their porridge.
text.T1: Elyo nomba ishi nkalamo shibili shaile patebulo ukuti shisende umusunga washiko.
text.T2: Elyo inkalamo shitatu shaile kwi tebulo ukuti shisende umusunga washiko.

text.S1: "WHAT’S THIS!” growled the father lion, in his great big voice, “SOMEBODY’S BEEN TASTING MY PORRIDGE, AND LEFT THE SPOON ON THE TABLE.”
text.T1: "NIFINSHI IFI!" efyabulwime wishi nkalamo, mucilishiwi icikulu, "KULI UWACILALYA UMUSUNGA WANDI, ELYO YASHA NA SUPUNI PA TEBULO."
text.T2: "NIFINSHI IFI!" efyabulwime wishi nkalamo, mucili shiwi icikulu. "KULI UWACILALYA UMUSUNGA WANDI, ELYO YASHA NA SUPUNI PA TEBULO ".

text.S1: "And somebody’s been taking my porridge,” said the mother lion in her middle-sized voice, “and they’ve splashed it all over.”
text.T1: "Elyo kuli uwacila seenda umusunga wandi," efyasosele nyina nkalamo mwishiwi lya petama," ba sabaushisha namonse- monse."
text.T2: "Elyo kuli uwacila senda umusunga wandi", efyasosele nyina nkalamo mwishiwi lya petama, "ba sabaushisha namonse-monse.

text.S1: "And somebody’s been tasting my porridge,” squealed the baby lion, “and they finished it.” And the baby lion looked sad as if he were about to cry.
text.T1: Elyo kuli uwacilalyapo umusunga wandi," efyasasawike akaana ka nkalamo, "Elyo naba u pwisha." Elyo akaana ka nkalamo kamoneka ukufulwa kwati kalefwaya ukulila.
text.T2: " Elyo kuli uwacilalyapo umusunga wandi", efyasasawike akaana ka nkalamo",Elyo naba upwisha". "Elyo akaana ka nkalamo kamoneka ukufulwa kwati kalefwaaya ukuliila

text.S1: "If somebody’s been here they must be here still,” said the mother lion; so the three lions went upstairs to look.
text.T1: " Ngacakuti mwaciba umo muno ninshi emoacili,"efyasosele nyina nkalamo, efyo inkalamo shonse shitatu shaninine pa mulu mukufwaya.
text.T2: "Ngacishinka mwaciba umo muno ninshi emo acili, "efyasosele nyina nkalamo, efyo nkalamo shonse shitatu shaninine pa muulu mukufwaya.

text.S1: First the father lion looked at his bed. “SOMEBODY’S BEEN LYING ON MY BED AND PULLED THE COVERS DOWN,” he growled in his great big voice.
text.T1: Pakubala wishi was nkalamo alolesha pa BUSAANSHI bwakwe. "PALI UWACISENDAMA PABUSANSHI BWANDI ATONSELA NEFYAKUFIMBANA PANSHI," efyo yabulwime mwishiwi iikalamba.
text.T2: Pakubala wishi nkalamo alolesha pa BUSANSHI bwakwe. "PALI UWACISENDAMA PA BUSANSHI BWANDI ATONSELA NEFYAKUFIMBANA PANSHI ", efyo yabulwime mwishiwi iikalamba. .

text.S1: Then the mother lion looked at her bed. “Somebody’s been lying on my bed and pulled the pillow off,” said she in her middle-sized voice.
text.T1: Ilyo Bana nkalamo ba loleshepa busanshi bwabo. " Pali uwacilambalala pa busanshi bwandi Elyo aseshapo umusao," basosele mwishiwi lya mukati.
text.T2: Ilyo nyina nkalamo ba loleshepa busanshi bwabo. " Pali uwacilambalala pa busanshi bwandi, Elyo aseseshepo umusao, ‘basosele mwishiwi lya mukati.

text.S1: Then the baby lion looked at his bed, and there lay little Goldi-locs with her cheeks as pink as roses, and her golden hair all spread over the pillow.
text.T1: Ilyo mwana nkalamo alolesha pa busanshi, Elyo palya paikele ka Goldi-Locs notumasaya tea kashikila nga maluba ya Rose, elyo no mushishi wa golide ulabalikwe pa musao.
text.T2: Ilyo mwana nkalamo alolesha pa busanshi, elyo palya paikele ka Goldi-locs notumasaya twakashikila nga maluba ya Rose, elyo no mushishi wa golide ulabalikwe pa musao.

text.S1: “Somebody’s been lying in my bed,” squeaked the baby lion joyfully, “and she is still here!”
text.T1: "Pali uwaci lambalala pabusanshi bwandi,"efyasosele mwana nkalamo nensansa,"Elyo emo acili!"
text.T2: "Pali uwacilambalala pa busanshi bwandi", efyasosele mwana nkalamo nensansa, "Elyo emo acili!"

text.S1: Now when Goldi-Locs heard the great big father lion’s voice she dreamed it was the thunder rolling through the heavens.
text.T1: Nomba Elyo Goldi-Locs aumfwa icili shiwi cabawishi nkalamo alotele icilulumo cilebulumina mu muulu.
text.T2: Nomba lintu Goldi-locs aumfwile icili shiwi caba wishi nkalamo alotele icilulumo cilebulumina mu muulu.

text.S1: And when she heard the mother lion’s middle-sized voice, she dreamed it was the wind blowing through the trees.
text.T1: Ilyo aaumfwile ishiwii lyaba nyina nkalamo ilyapakati alotele umwela ulepupila mufimuti.
text.T2: Ilyo aumfwileishiwi lya nyinankalamo , alotele ukutiila mwela ulepupila mufi muti.

text.S1: But when she heard the baby lion’s voice it was so shrill and sharp that it woke her right up. She sat up in bed and there were the three lions standing around and looking at her.
text.T1: Lelo Ilyo aumfwile ishiwi lyakana ka nkalamo ilyali pamulu ilya te icakuti lyamubusha. Alimine nokwikala pabusaanshi ninshi na nkalamo nashimushinguluka Elyo shilemulolesha.
text.T2: Lelo ilyo aumfwile ishiwi lya kaana ka nkalamo ilyali pa muulu lya icakuti lya mbusha. Alimine nokwikala pa busanshi ninshi na nkalamo nashi mushinguluka elyo shilemulolesha.

text.S1: “Oh, my goodness me!” cried Goldi-Locs. She tumbled out of bed and ran to the window. It was open, and out she jumped before the lions could stop her. Then home she ran as fast as she could, and she never went near the forest again. And the little baby lion cried and cried because he had wanted to play with her.
text.T1: " Yangu ee inee!" efyalilile Goli-Locs. Aimine ulubilo pabusaanshi no kubutukila ku ntolokoso. Yali iyaisuka, nokutoloka Ilyo inkalamo tashila mulesha. Elyo abutwike ulubilo lwacipeshamano, kabili tabwelelemo namu mpanga libili. Elyo akaana ka nkalamo kalilile pantu kalefwaya ukwangala nankwe.
text.T2: "Yangu ee inee!" efyalilile Goldi-Locs. Aimine ulubilo pa busanshi no kubutukila ku intolokoso. Yali iyaisuka, nokutoloka ilyo inkalamo tashila mulesha. Elyo abutwike ulubilo lwacipesha amano, kabili tabwelelemo namu mpanga libili. Elyo akaana ka nkalamo kalililile pantu kalefwaya ukwangala nankwe.
